requirement.statement: Eidolon workflow run tools SHALL reuse existing detached actor runtime facts for AI agent task execution and observation instead of introducing a workflow-specific runtime store.

case.given: a workflow run request contains a valid workflow resource ref
case.then: the tool SHALL delegate execution to Eidolon actor infrastructure and return detached task evidence

case.given: a workflow run id maps to a detached actor task id
case.then: the tools SHALL read existing detached actor registry or observability facts
